message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents a comprehensive overview of climate science and the urgent need for action. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film and highlights new scientific findings. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the impacts of climate change and discusses solutions. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC production that explains the science behind climate change, its effects, and policy responses. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from science, business, and faith communities. |

All of these are available on major streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or YouTube). If you’d like more details on any particular film—such as runtime, availability, or critical reception—just let me know!
